name: One-Pot Thai Green Chicken Curry
steps: Slice the chicken thighs into bite-sized pieces. Trim the baby corn and mange tout. Finely slice the red chilli. Pick some coriander leaves for garnish and cut the lime into wedges.
Set a large saucepan over a medium heat. Pour in half the coconut milk and cook for 5 mins until the fat starts to split and it smells toasty.
Add the Thai Green Curry Paste and stir for another 5 mins until darker and super fragrant. Tip in the chicken and cook for 3–4 mins until just sealed.
Sprinkle in the sugar and let it bubble and caramelise for 2 mins. Pour in half the fish sauce and scrape up any sticky bits.
Add the rest of the coconut milk and the chicken stock. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 15 mins until slightly thickened and the chicken’s cooked through.
Chuck in the baby corn and mange tout for the final 2 mins. Stir through most of the coriander and the remaining fish sauce. Taste and season.
Serve over cooked rice and top with fresh chilli, crispy shallots, coriander leaves and a wedge of lime.
